name: asap-australia
description: Plugins for driving and instrumenting games from Claude — headless game control, screen vision, input injection and mod-script tooling.

plugins.name: easy-red-2
plugins.description: See, drive and instrument Easy Red 2 from Claude. Runs the game headless in a gamescope harness (no host window, never touches your cursor), returns screenshots inline, injects clicks and keys, executes Lua in the in-game F3 console for live tuning, tails mod telemetry from Player.log, and syntax-validates + deploys mission and AI-brain scripts.
